LESSON: WAKATI ULIOPO

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.6: wakati uliopo

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo ni somo la kusoma: wakati uliopo. Soma maelezo, fuata mifano iliyofanyiwa kazi, kisha fanya mazoezi.

SEHEMU 2: MALENGO

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. explain what wakati uliopo means in simple pupil language
2. give 3 correct examples of wakati uliopo from Kenya
3. practise wakati uliopo in clear steps
4. apply wakati uliopo in one real-life situation this week

SEHEMU 3: SOMO (MAELEZO NA MIFANO)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: WAKATI ULIOPO
Subject: KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES · Grade: Grade 1
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
wakati uliopo helps you succeed in KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES. You will understand it, practise it, and use it nyumbani, shuleni, na sokoni.

KEY FACTS: WAKATI ULIOPO
Study wakati uliopo like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Explain what wakati uliopo means in simple pupil language

What this means
In this part you learn to explain what wakati uliopo means in simple pupil language. You will use ideas from nyumbani, shuleni, na sokoni.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: explain what wakati uliopo means in simple pupil language.
2. Soma, sema, kisha andika using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Mfano wa kusoma: Soma sentensi fupi kuhusu “wakati uliopo”, kisha eleza kwa maneno yako.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can explain what wakati uliopo means in simple pupil language. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Give 3 correct examples of wakati uliopo from Kenya

What this means
In this part you learn to give 3 correct examples of wakati uliopo from Kenya. You will use ideas from nyumbani, shuleni, na sokoni.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: give 3 correct examples of wakati uliopo from Kenya.
2. Soma, sema, kisha andika using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Mfano wa kuzungumza: Zungumza na rafiki kwa dakika 1 kuhusu wakati uliopo.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can give 3 correct examples of wakati uliopo from Kenya. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 3: Practise wakati uliopo in clear steps

What this means
In this part you learn to practise wakati uliopo in clear steps. You will use ideas from nyumbani, shuleni, na sokoni.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: practise wakati uliopo in clear steps.
2. Soma, sema, kisha andika using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Mfano wa kuandika: Andika sentensi 3 sahihi kuhusu wakati uliopo.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can practise wakati uliopo in clear steps. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 4: Apply wakati uliopo in one real-life situation this week

What this means
In this part you learn to apply wakati uliopo in one real-life situation this week. You will use ideas from nyumbani, shuleni, na sokoni.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: apply wakati uliopo in one real-life situation this week.
2. Soma, sema, kisha andika using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Mfano wa kusoma: Soma sentensi fupi kuhusu “wakati uliopo”, kisha eleza kwa maneno yako.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can apply wakati uliopo in one real-life situation this week. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what wakati uliopo is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO YA HARAKA

Example 1: Soma sentensi fupi kuhusu “wakati uliopo”, kisha eleza kwa maneno yako. (skill: explain what wakati uliopo means in simple pupil language)

Example 2: Zungumza na rafiki kwa dakika 1 kuhusu wakati uliopo. (skill: give 3 correct examples of wakati uliopo from Kenya)

Example 3: Andika sentensi 3 sahihi kuhusu wakati uliopo. (skill: practise wakati uliopo in clear steps)

Example 4: Soma sentensi fupi kuhusu “wakati uliopo”, kisha eleza kwa maneno yako. (skill: apply wakati uliopo in one real-life situation this week)

SEHEMU 5: MAZOEZI

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach wakati uliopo to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: explain what wakati uliopo means in simple pupil language.
3. Practise this skill: give 3 correct examples of wakati uliopo from Kenya.
4. Practise this skill: practise wakati uliopo in clear steps.
5. Make one local Kenya example of wakati uliopo from your county, market, farm, or school.
6. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA NYUMBANI

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for wakati uliopo: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 1 learner study wakati uliopo?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. Know what wakati uliopo means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: explain what wakati uliopo means in simple pupil language.
5. Be able to: give 3 correct examples of wakati uliopo from Kenya.

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
